tiles.label: Capital expenditures
tiles.foot: Purchases of property and equipment in the quarter

sections.title: Diluted loss per share by quarter
sections.callout: Q4 2025: loss per share of $0.80, narrowed from $0.87 a year earlier.

footnotes: Fourth quarters (Q4 2024, Q4 2025) have no 10-Q: they are the full year in the 10-K less the nine months in the third-quarter 10-Q.
Cash flow figures are reported year-to-date; each quarter is the year-to-date total less the previous quarter's. Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property and equipment.

Diluted EPS is not additive across quarters. Where the filing gives no three-month EPS (fourth quarters), it is calculated as net income to common ÷ estimated diluted shares (the full-year weighted average × 4 less the nine-month average × 3), and may differ from the reported figure by a cent or two.
Debt = long-term debt including the current portion; excludes leases.
The company reports no cost of revenue line, so net revenue flows straight to operating expenses.
Interest & other, net = pre-tax income − operating income. Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding. QoQ compares with Q3 2025; YoY with Q4 2024.
The company reports no revenue.

events.t: Appointment of Andrew Miller to the Board On February 24, 2026, the board of directors (the “Board”) of Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc. (the “Company”) appointed Andrew Miller, Ph.D. as a Class III director of the Company, effective immediately.

Resignation of Karen Walker as Chief Technology Officer On January 29, 2026, Karen Walker notified Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc. (the “Company”) that she will be retiring from the Company and will cease to serve as the Company’s Chief Technology Officer, effective February 9, 2026.
On January 8, 2026, the Board appointed Christi Shaw, a current member of the Board, as the Company’s Executive Chairperson of the Board, effective January 12, 2026 (the “Effective Date”).

On December 17, 2025, Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc. (the “Company”) entered into an underwriting agreement (the “Underwriting Agreement”) with J.P.
